metadata.methodology: Official Chick-fil-A location sitemaps define the 50-state and District of Columbia public record universe. Exact display coordinates come from openly licensed OpenStreetMap features tagged brand=Chick-fil-A within the same geography. Official records without an exact open-map match are counted but not assigned invented coordinates.
metadata.limitations: This is a point-in-time public snapshot, not an official operational master. Sitemap pages may include licensed, campus, planned, relocated, or recently changed records. OpenStreetMap coverage is community-maintained and may omit or duplicate locations.
